expectations.text: A PNG deliverable exists with its long side at least 2000 pixels (300-dpi render scale)
The image is wider than tall (PAE matrix panel rendered alongside the structure, aspect ratio > 1.3)
The structure is colored by pLDDT confidence (blue-to-yellow/orange gradient over the chain), not by chain or rainbow position colors
expectations.evidence: Viewed q5vsl9_plddt_pae.png: the single chain runs from deep blue (well-ordered helical core) through green into yellow/orange terminal/loop segments — the AlphaFold pLDDT ramp; coloring tracks local order, not N-to-C position. Corroborated by `--color plddt` in commands.log.

expectations.text: A PAE matrix heat-map panel is visible in the image
expectations.evidence: Viewed q5vsl9_plddt_pae.png: the right ~40% of the canvas is a PAE heat map — a square panel with a dark low-error diagonal band and lighter off-diagonal blocks, clearly a separate panel from the structure.

expectations.text: interpretation.md exists and cites specific regions (residue numbers or domain/range descriptions) as high- vs low-confidence
interpretation.md identifies at least one low-confidence/disordered segment

notes: Single render.py call with `--color plddt --pae`, then export with `--page --dpi 300` captured the full two-panel layout (2800x2000, ratio 1.40) in one shot. The runner went beyond the assertions: pulled the AF confidence/PAE JSONs plus UniProt domain features and computed smoothed per-segment pLDDT and inter-domain PAE block means to ground interpretation.md in real numbers.
